tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Background of every screen, the tab bar and the bottom bars. Never cream.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, icons, the outline of photos and of secondary buttons, the rating's star.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and input borders. Passes AA on bg and on the three service colors.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The primary button, the active tab and the Súper Cuidador placa. Text on it: white.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of the primary button. Text on it: white.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Level and certification placas, the active tab's pill, notices and selected options.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and soft edges. Never the only edge of an input.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Badge placas, search chips, inputs and the few surfaces that group fields.

tokens.name: paseo
tokens.usage: Only the walk. Text on it: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: visita
tokens.usage: Only the home visit. Text on it: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: pernocta
tokens.usage: Only the overnight stay. Text on it: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Only the ⭐ of the special care certification. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, the border of an input with an error and destructive actions. 6.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error notices, with danger text (4.8:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The caregiver's name in the profile and the hero of Bienvenida.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Names in rows and the name of a service block.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The price of each search result.

styles.name: price-small
styles.usage: Prices in the profile, totals and bottom bars.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons (18px in the primary one), option chips and field labels.

styles.name: placa
styles.usage: The text of a placa (13px in lists) and the tab labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ana cuidará a Luna el sábado de 9:00 a 13:00.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, values in summaries and search chips.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: The smallest text in the app: the unit under a price, the line of a service block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a title and its subtitle, and inside small stacks of text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label, and between placas.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a photo and the text next to it, and between fields side by side.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of notices and surfaces.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The side gutter of every screen (gutter).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Around empty-state art and at the end of a scroll.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Option rows inside sheets, swatches and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, placas, inputs and notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Big surfaces: service blocks, the top corners of sheets and the level placa.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Round things: pet photos, the ⭐ medal, the tab pill and search chips.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and soft edges in line; inputs in ink-muted; badge placas in ink.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, outlined icon buttons and selected chips, in ink.

tokens.name: border-selected
tokens.usage: The selected service block, in ink.

shadow.usage: There are no shadows: surfaces are told apart by color, borders or dividers.
